login.title: Welcome back
login.body: Sign in to your Rheino customer account.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.body: Set up a Rheino account for your business.

forgot-password.title: Forgot your password?
forgot-password.body: Enter the email you use for Rheino and we’ll send you a secure reset link.

reset-password.title: Set a new password
reset-password.body: Choose a long, unique password for your Rheino account.

verify-email.title: Verify your email
verify-email.body: Confirm your email address to activate your account.

CustomerAuth.resendBody: Enter your email address to request a new verification link.
CustomerAuth.checkSpam: It can take a few minutes. If the email hasn’t arrived, check your spam folder.
CustomerAuth.business: I confirm that I’m registering on behalf of a business.
CustomerAuth.verified: Email confirmed. You can now sign in.
CustomerAuth.resetDone: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.
CustomerAuth.accountBody: These are the details for your Rheino business account.

errors.passwordSymbol: Add a special character such as !, @ or #.
errors.commonPassword: Choose a less common password or a longer passphrase.
errors.businessRequired: Please confirm that you’re registering for a business.
errors.invalidCredentials: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your email and password, or reset your password.
errors.unverified: Verify your email to sign in.
errors.invalidLink: This link is invalid, has expired, or has already been used.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.unavailable: We couldn’t complete that request. Please try again shortly.
errors.signupSent: If your address can be registered, you’ll receive a link to verify your email.
errors.resetSent: If an account is registered to that email, you’ll receive a password reset link.
errors.verificationSent: If the address still needs verification, you’ll receive a new link.
errors.invalidSecondFactor: That code couldn’t be verified. Try a fresh code or use a recovery code.

CustomerAuth.factorBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app or use one of your recovery codes.
CustomerAuth.continueOrder: Sign in or create an account to finish your order. Your selection is saved and you'll come straight back to it.

CustomerPortal.title: My account
CustomerPortal.intro: Manage your profile and sign-in settings.
CustomerPortal.profileIntro: Keep your contact and business information up to date.
CustomerPortal.emailHint: This is your verified sign-in address.
CustomerPortal.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with at least three digits.
CustomerPortal.invalidVat: Enter a valid VAT ID using letters and numbers.
CustomerPortal.invalidCountry: Enter a two-letter country code, such as DE.
CustomerPortal.securityIntro: Manage your password and two-step verification.
CustomerPortal.passwordIntro: Changing your password signs you out on all devices.
CustomerPortal.mfaIntro: Use a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
CustomerPortal.scanBody: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code below.
CustomerPortal.qrAlt: QR code for your Rheino authenticator setup
CustomerPortal.disableBody: Confirm your current password and a verification or recovery code to turn this off.
CustomerPortal.recoveryIntro: Each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator. Download them now and store them somewhere safe.
CustomerPortal.setupExpired: This setup expired. Confirm your password to start again.
CustomerPortal.invalidCredentials: Your current password could not be verified.
CustomerPortal.secondFactorRequired: Enter a code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
CustomerPortal.ordersIntro: Payments, status and delivery for everything you ordered.
